searchText: This might help give more detail on validator index re-use, this was asked a while back too: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/595701173944713277/646999635545817088 Yeah I remember that discussion, I still think this is something we may want to at least give a shot, the validator registry growth is a concern in many places as well, and while still churned as it is now, we may as well help reduce the burden by trying to reuse indices If skimming is in place then I suspect that validator churn won't be very high. May be a situation where we wait until withdrawals are available, evaluate its impact, and then mitigate it if against projected long-term downside of not reusing them.
